display.purpose: Hero section headlines only. The rotating subject name (الرياضيات, الفيزياء). Never in app UI.

headline.purpose: Page-level section headings — courses header, library title.

title.purpose: Card headings, panel titles, modal headers.

body.purpose: Descriptions, content prose, AI chat. Max 65ch for Arabic readability.

label.purpose: Nav links, button text, form labels, metadata chips. The workhorse.

shadows.name: hover-glow-white
shadows.purpose: White CTA button hover — ambient light burst, not a lift.

shadows.name: focus-ring-sky
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus indicator on all interactive elements.

shadows.name: nav-depth
shadows.purpose: Sticky nav shadow — reinforces sticky position without floating.

shadows.name: card-hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Interactive card hover lift. Never at rest.

motion.name: ease-expo-out
motion.purpose: Primary ease for entrances and exits. All hero stagger animations.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default for state transitions (button hover, nav link, color shifts). 160ms.

motion.name: spring-spotlight
motion.purpose: Cursor-following hero spotlight. Framer Motion useSpring only.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action button. Sky blue, rounded, tactile press. Used for enrollment, submit, login.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2563eb; color: #ffffff; padding: 12px 28px; border-radius: 12px; font-family: Cairo, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; direction: rtl; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1d4ed8; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(59,130,246,0.18); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Hero CTA Button
components.description: Pill-shaped white CTA button for the hero section. Has a shimmer sweep on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-cta { position: relative; background: #ffffff; color: #0b0f19; padding: 14px 32px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Cairo, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; border: none; cursor: pointer; overflow: hidden; transition: box-shadow 160ms ease; direction: rtl; } .ds-btn-cta:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(255,255,255,0.25); } .ds-btn-cta:hover .ds-btn-cta-shimmer { left: 115%; } .ds-btn-cta-label { position: relative; z-index: 1; } .ds-btn-cta-shimmer { position: absolute; inset-y: 0; left: -45%; width: 33%; transform: skewX(-12deg); background: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, rgba(165,180,252,0.60), transparent); filter: blur(2px); transition: left 700ms ease-out; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action. Subtle background, border. Used for 'Explore Courses', cancel actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); color: #e2e8f0; padding: 12px 28px; border-radius: 12px; font-family: Cairo, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10); cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease; direction: rtl; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.10); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.20); color: #ffffff; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(59,130,246,0.18); }

components.name: Grade Chip
components.description: Grade/stage shortcut pill. Used in hero section and course filter bar.
components.css: .ds-chip-grade { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.70); font-family: Cairo, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; transition: background 200ms ease, border-color 200ms ease, color 200ms ease; direction: rtl; } .ds-chip-grade:hover { background: rgba(99,102,241,0.15); border-color: rgba(99,102,241,0.40); color: #ffffff; } .ds-chip-grade-arrow { color: #a5b4fc; display: inline-block; transition: transform 200ms ease; } .ds-chip-grade:hover .ds-chip-grade-arrow { transform: translateX(-2px); }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Navigation link in the sticky top nav. Active state uses sky accent.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: Cairo, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #94a3b8; text-decoration: none; transition: color 160ms ease, background 160ms ease; direction: rtl; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #e2e8f0; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); } .ds-nav-link--active { color: #7dd3fc; background: rgba(14,165,233,0.15); }

components.name: Course Card
components.description: Course listing card. Thumbnail + stage badge + title + teacher name. Hover lifts.

components.css: .ds-course-card { background: rgba(15,23,42,0.78); border: 1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.16); border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden; cursor: pointer; transition: box-shadow 200ms ease, transform 200ms ease; direction: rtl; } .ds-course-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.18); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-course-thumb { width: 100%; height: 160px; background: #1e293b; } .ds-course-body { padding: 16px; } .ds-course-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(37,99,235,0.15); color: #93c5fd; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-course-title { color: #e2e8f0; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4; margin: 0 0 6px; font-family: Cairo, sans-serif; } .ds-course-teacher { color: #94a3b8; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 400; margin: 0; font-family: Cairo, sans-serif; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form field. Used in login, signup, course creation. RTL-native.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; direction: rtl; } .ds-label { font-family: Cairo, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #e2e8f0; } .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 12px 16px; background: #1e293b; border: 1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.22); border-radius: 12px; color: #e2e8f0; font-family: Cairo, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; direction: rtl; transition: border-color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #64748b; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: rgba(59,130,246,0.5); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(59,130,246,0.18); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Skeleton Loader
components.description: Shimmer placeholder for data-loading states. Never a centered spinner.
components.css: @keyframes ds-shimmer { 0% { background-position: -200% 0; } 100% { background-position: 200% 0; } } .ds-skeleton { background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(15,23,42,0.78) 25%, rgba(148,163,184,0.16) 50%, rgba(15,23,42,0.78) 75%); background-size: 200% 100%; animation: ds-shimmer 1.5s infinite; border-radius: 8px; width: 100%; height: 20px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-skeleton { animation: none; background: rgba(148,163,184,0.10); } }

narrative.overview:
Code-UP looks and feels like the best exam preparation center in Egypt — one students pay for and trust with their academic futures. The interface is confident, focused, and unhurried. It never performs busyness. The dark-native surfaces reduce eye strain for students studying late at night; the light mode is an option, not the default. The typography is Arabic-first (Cairo), with scale ratios calibrated for RTL reading rhythm. Every interactive element responds with quiet precision — a subtle shadow on press, a smooth color shift — without choreography that wastes the student's time.

The system explicitly rejects the following: the generic blue-and-white 'global EdTech' aesthetic (Coursera, edX) that signals 'not made for us'; the cluttered Arabic portal pattern with competing banners, pop-ups, and autoplay; and SaaS dashboard chrome (metric cards, sidebar layouts, data tables) on student-facing pages. Code-UP is a learning tool, not a productivity app.

Color strategy is Restrained: dark-navy surfaces carry the canvas; one saturated sky-blue accent marks primary actions and navigation state. The indigo glow is reserved for the hero section only — a signature moment, not a pattern.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-native canvas (near-black ink-deep #0b0f19) with sky-blue as the single accent
Arabic-first (RTL, Cairo), weights from 400–900 across the scale
Spacing varies deliberately; rhythm over uniformity
Framer Motion for entrance and state transitions; never orchestrated page-load sequences on the app surface
Reduced motion respected unconditionally — every animation has a crossfade fallback
Touch-first tap targets (≥44px), keyboard-navigable, WCAG AA contrast throughout

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Sky Action Blue is used on ≤10% of any given screen. Its rarity is exactly what makes it legible as 'tap here.' Avoid using it for decorative borders, backgrounds, or icons that don't invite interaction.

rules.name: The Hero Signature Rule
rules.body: Indigo Glow (#6366f1) is exclusively a hero-section material — spotlight, glow, background atmosphere. Applying it to buttons, cards, or navigation in the app surface is prohibited.

rules.name: The Single Family Rule
rules.body: Cairo only. No serif display pairing, no 'brand font' injected for headings. Consistency of shape across the interface is the signal of quality.

rules.name: The Weight Axis Rule
rules.body: Weight is the hierarchy, not size alone. A 700 title at 1.25rem outranks a 400 body at 1.5rem. Never use font-weight: 400 for headings.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. The eye navigates by tonal contrast between --card and --background, not by shadow. Applying shadows to static cards, panels, or text blocks is prohibited.

dos: Do use Cairo at 700–900 for all headings. Weight is the hierarchy signal.
Do use Sky Action Blue (#2563eb) exclusively for interactive affordances — buttons, links, active nav state, focus rings. Not for decoration.
Do verify ≥4.5:1 contrast for every text element including placeholders and muted labels.
Do use skeleton loaders on every data-fetching surface. Loading states are not edge cases.
Do keep tap targets ≥44px. Every nav link, button, and chip must be touchable on a small phone screen.
Do provide a prefers-reduced-motion fallback for every Framer Motion animation.
Do respect RTL throughout: direction: rtl on <html>, flip directional icons, no LTR-only layout assumptions.
Do use the tonal layer system (Ink Muted Bg → Ink Surface → Ink Card) to communicate depth.
Do vary spacing deliberately across the full scale from xs(4) to 2xl(64).
donts: Don't use the generic blue-and-white 'global EdTech' aesthetic (Coursera, edX). Code-UP's identity is dark-navy with sky accent.
Don't use cluttered Arabic portal patterns: competing banners, pop-ups, autoplay content.
Don't bring SaaS dashboard chrome — metric cards, hero-metric templates, sidebar + topbar layouts — onto student-facing pages.
Don't use background-clip: text gradient text. Gradient text is decorative and fails accessibility.
Don't use border-left or border-right > 1px as a colored stripe on cards or alerts.
Don't apply Indigo Glow (#6366f1) outside the hero section.
Don't gate content visibility on a class-toggled transition. Animations must enhance visible content, not reveal hidden content.
Don't use drop shadows on static surfaces. Shadows are state-feedback only.
Don't apply backdrop-filter: blur decoratively — use only where there is genuinely layered content beneath.
Don't animate layout properties (height, width, padding). Animate transform and opacity only.
Don't use identical card grids — same icon + heading + text, repeated in a uniform grid.
